stopped.message: Stopping restores the original volume. Pause playback first.

hint.message: Keeps working with the popup closed. Page volume combines with app and master volume. Stopping restores original volume; pause playback first.

reopen.message: Close and reopen this popup to try again.

errorCapture.message: This page could not share its audio. Reload it and try again.

errorTimeout.message: Audio did not start in time. Try again.

errorTabEnded.message: This tab is no longer controlled. Enable it again.

errorUnavailable.message: Open this extension on a regular web page.

errorPermission.message: Audio access was denied. Open the extension on this page and try again.

errorOperation.message: The change could not be applied. Try again.

extensionDescription.message: Control volume and mute for individual tabs. Audio stays on your device; nothing is recorded or uploaded.
